summary: Project scaffolding: pyproject.toml, src/harness package skeleton, tests layout, CI workflow.
Core primitives: Clock/IdGen protocols with real + deterministic implementations, HarnessError hierarchy.
Pydantic v2 config model mirroring concept §4 + YAML loader raising ConfigError on malformed/unknown/out-of-policy config.
ProjectFolder canonical paths + typed read/write + DeclaredIOGuard enforcing per-stage input/output confinement.
run.log JSON-lines + DECISIONS/PROGRESS markdown+JSON mirrors kept in sync + resume_state from progress.json.
Pure BudgetGuard: cost estimation from rate table, accumulation, warn-once, pre-emptive BudgetExceeded.
freeze_spec snapshots concept+guidelines into hashed spec/.lock/<version>/; read_frozen verifies hash; latest_version/is_stale detect invalidation.
TicketNode + deterministic Kahn's-algorithm topological_order; DagCycleError on cycles; empty DAG handled.
render_prompt() template loader with project-override support + 8 first-draft default templates.
deviations: Added PromptError(HarnessError) to core/errors.py; see DECISIONS.md.

Sandbox: confine() file-confinement guard + build_docker_command()/run() for container execution; Docker-gated smoke test.
CodingAgentAdapter protocol + AgentResult + CodingAgentContract suite + FakeCodingAgent (scripted writes via sandbox.confine).

summary: apply_gate() with injected IO for approve/edit/reject + auto_approve + phase_boundary_should_stop().
Stage Protocol (inputs/outputs/run->StageResult) + declared_io_for() wiring stages into the T-040 guard.

Stage.inputs/outputs widened to read-only properties in base.py for property-based implementations.

summary: run_review_gate(): automated checks gate the reviewer call; async via asyncio.to_thread wrapping the sync ClaudeCodeAdapter.review(); gatherable.
deviations: asyncio.to_thread wraps T-140's synchronous review(); see DECISIONS.md.

deviations: Full-suite test scoping per DECISIONS.md (T-210); phase-stop satisfied structurally via T-190's phase-scoped ticket files; sandbox typed as concrete Sandbox class.
